materialFindings.summary: Limited public exact-name searches did not establish a material exact Reeris UI software-framework collision; this is not a comprehensive conflict search.
The public Eristavi/ReerisUI repository is accessible under the intended owner and name.
All six target public npm metadata endpoints returned 404 on 28 September 2026; this does not prove scope ownership or reserve package names.
The reeris.com and reerisui.com RDAP endpoints returned 404, while .dev requests returned 502; none of the domains was registered or authoritatively confirmed available.
A formal trademark similarity search and legal decision remain pending; public exact-name search is not legal advice.

decision: Continue development under Reeris UI. Keep the public-publication gate open pending npm account control, domain registration, and formal trademark/similarity clearance.
